description.en: A swimming eurypterid reconstruction with walking limbs, a paddle pair, twelve trunk segments and a straight telson. Thickness, posture and missing appendage ends are inferred from incomplete same-species fossils.
description.zh: 游泳型板足鲎复原，具有步行附肢、一对桨肢、十二节躯干与直尾剑。体厚、姿态和缺失附肢末端依据不完整同种化石推定。

anatomy: Compact subtrapezoidal rounded-front carapace, paired kidney-shaped lateral eyes and tiny median ocelli; shallow lateral embayments outside eyes distinguish remipes.

Twelve trunk tergites: six broader anterior segments followed by six narrowing posterior segments. Straight slender telson continues posterior axis, with subtle distal marginal serrations, never arched scorpion sting.
One pair small anterior chelicerae; four pairs walking limbs II-V. First three walking pairs relatively stout with restrained paired spines; fourth longer, slender and less spinose.
Sixth appendage pair forms broad oval distal swimming paddles on articulated stalks. Keep paddles distinct from legs and readable bilaterally. No oversized toothed claws.
Ventral metastoma and simplified operculum; modest TypeA median appendage may follow1758X without invented male structures. Do not expose internal bookgills as external fins.
Matte muted cuticle palette, living hues unknown; omit excessive tiny scales while preserving segmentation and outline.
restoration_boundaries: Plate1A MGM1758X is the actual ventral main specimen, approximately200mm straightened with most prosomal appendages. Photo and1cmbar actually viewed.
Plate1C MGM5868X shows dorsal head and paddle silhouette; original140mm plus missingtelson tip about10mm. Used for shape only, never mixed as200mm same individual.
Plate1B same-species specimens show serratedtelson and head embayment. Plate1D is E.tetragonophthalmus and must NOT be used.
Historic Clarke/Ruedemann1912 remipes description supports limb arrangement and twelve-segment trunk; modern2007 species separation takes precedence over old broad synonyms.
Missing extremities, gentle straightening and three-dimensional body volume interpretive, without claiming exact soft-tissue preservation.

scale.uncertainty: 200mm straightened total author estimate, not exact measurement. Subdivisions from Plate1A and same-species historical proportions; dorsal comparison supplies shape only.

scientific_limits.en: Interpretive reconstruction, not scan of a single complete carcass. Tetlie/Rabano2007 estimate MGM1758X about200mm if straight; specimen is ventral and bent. Dorsal carapace features supplemented from same-species MGM5868X, not its different150mm size. Depth, posture and missing limb tips inferred. TypeA genital appendage interpreted female, not proven sex. No giant pterygotid claws or modern scorpion sting.
scientific_limits.zh: 解释性复原，非完整尸体扫描。2007论文估MGM1758X若伸直约200毫米，原标本弯曲并为腹面。背甲细节参考同种MGM5868X，不借其150毫米尺寸。厚度姿态与缺损足端为推断，A型生殖附肢解释为雌性但非确定性别。不混巨型翼肢鲎钳或现代蝎毒刺。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete small-bodied swimming eurypterid with compact carapace, four walking-appendage pairs, a paddle pair, twelve tapering trunk segments and straight telson. Main anchor MGM1758X, with same-species dorsal comparison MGM5868X.
